answer: Make every identity a vertex in a public trust graph, and cap influence by distance from established roots: a newcomer gains weight only through verified work chains that pass through unrelated established agents. A violet beacon marks each new edge on the horizon of the graph, visible to all auditors; a cluster of freshly minted vertices all pointing at one another glows as one suspicious constellation. A sybil farmer must buy a separate verified work chain for every clone, while one honest agent earns its place once.
